name: Azure AI FAQ Bot
description: A FAQ chatbot block that embeds the Microsoft Bot Framework Web Chat widget and mints a Direct Line token server-side.
project_description: Azure AI FAQ Bot embeds a Microsoft Bot Framework Web Chat widget on a Drupal site as a block. It ships one settings form for a Direct Line secret, one controller route that exchanges that secret for a short-lived Direct Line token, a block that renders an empty container plus attached JS, and a small behavior that fetches the token and boots the Web Chat widget (loaded from cdn.botframework.com) against the Direct Line service. The bot itself (QnA Maker / Language Studio question-answering) is built and hosted on Azure; this module only wires the Drupal page to it. The Direct Line secret stays server-side and only the minted token is returned to the browser.
